params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given name.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

items.docs: Lists marketplace publisher partner info for a compartment.

info.name: Submits a CSV batch of usage records for marketplace offers.

items.docs:
Asynchronously submits a UTF-8 CSV usage file for marketplace offers. The file
must not exceed 50 MB or 30,000 rows and must include required usage columns.

info.name: Submits one or more usage records for marketplace offers.

items.docs:
Synchronously submits usage records for marketplace offers. Each record must include
`id`, `marketplaceOfferId`, `amount`, `currencyCode`, `timeUsageStarted`,
`timeUsageEnded`, and `usageDimensionName`.
